Maya (PM): quick thread 3we've gotten mixed signals on where the "performance" badges should live in the model catalog. Some users prefer them next to the model name; others only notice them when adjacent to p99. Also heard a handful saying pinned versions lose a small set of active filters which is surprising. want to settle both UI and copy for the prototype.

Theo (Design): two proposals: (A) badge next to name, larger 16px + sr-only label; (B) badge embedded with p99, smaller but contextual. i'll mock both with visible microtext variant "fast / balanced / slow" for desktop. for pin+filters: propose microcopy in the pin modal: "Keep my current filters with this pin" and a small pill when enabled that reads "filters saved".

Ravi (Frontend): from implementation, (A) is simpler; (B) requires moving badges into metric cells which complicates virtualized rows a bit but doable. for saved filters, client-side localStorage keyed by user+model+version is fastest. include TTL and safe-guards if filter keys disappear.

June (A11y): accessibility items: badges must not rely on color alone; each badge needs a textual label for screen readers. if we show microtext, ensure contrast >= 4.5. When restoring filters, announce via aria-live: "Filters restored for pinned version X". Also ensure keyboard discoverability for badge tooltip: it must be reachable by Tab and not only hover.

Theo (Design): microcopy options for badge tooltip: "Performance: fast" or shorter visible token "fast". prefer tooltip + sr-only for compact view. will include delta chips (e.g., "+3%") next to p99 — but only show % on hover to reduce clutter.

Ravi (Frontend): plan: implement behind feature flag. lazy-render expanded metric content, respect prefers-reduced-motion, provide aria-expanded on chevron controls. localStorage key sample: `ri:filters:{orgId}:{userId}:{modelId}:{versionId}`. will set 90-day TTL. when saved filters include removed facet, ignore and show toast: "One saved filter no longer available."

June (A11y): checklist before merge: 1) badge has accessible name and not color-dependent; 2) delta chips have aria-labels; 3) filter-restore announcement exists; 4) contrast checks pass; 5) keyboard focus order validated. i'll review the PR.

qa-bot: created quick QA checklist: visual A/B, keyboard-only flow, mobile tap behavior, filter-restore toast case.

Maya (PM): decision: ship (A) badge-next-to-name for the first pass (easier), with sr-only label and visible microtext variant behind flag. include client-side opt-in "remember filters" in pin modal. Theo will upload mocks; Ravi will open PR behind flag; June + QA will run quick tests on dev. target: dev deploy next week. :rocket:
